DeviceProgram.description:
Append commands to the controller buffer, optionally executing that buffer.

Reports and immediate controls are separate commands, never buffer members.
A prior controller buffer is unknown: compilation cannot assert its length,
content, initialization, physical effects or completion.

families.semantics: W initialization positively evidenced in P p2 and newly recovered E p5: full stroke up and down. Full command table unavailable; variants, parameters, defaults unresolved. Do not invent W variants.

families.source_residual: M pp33–34 missing; p35 continuation alone not all-variant authority
families.semantics: A absolute, P relative aspirate, D relative dispense; n2=1 microliters established by P guide/M pp28-30. n2=0 increment selector appears in orphaned relative-position continuation p35. That table has n1 0–44000 increments/default0 or 0.000–1100.000 microliters/up to3 decimals; n2 default0. Missing heading means cannot attribute all these ranges to each A/P/D variant. No claim to have enumerated undocumented/lowercase variants.

n2=0/default increments/s: n1 1.0–40000.0, default8000.0; n2=1 microliters/s:0.025–1000.000/up to3 decimals, documentary default still8000.0 inc/s. Conversion depends configured max volume, rounds to0.1 inc/s. Omitted parameter resets increment default.

v:100–4000 inc/s/default1000 or2.500–100.000 microliters/s. c:100–8000 inc/s/default2000 or2.500–200.000 microliters/s. n2=0/default increments,1 microliters; volume form3 decimals, integer increment rounding. Device temporarily reduces effective start/cutoff to top while reports programmed values. p36 advises against cutoff>100 microliters/s; P p9 recipes200 remain conflicting evidence, not new limit.
L each1–40/default20, each unit20000 inc/s²; independent up/down. K0–500/default0 increments, applied end of aspiration; not reaspiration or liquid correction.

families.source_residual: h full definition absent in recovered command pages
families.semantics: h high/low current is expressly persisted/restored by i/r, queried ?11/?12/?15 (p45). Setter syntax/ranges/defaults not recovered. A positive feature reference, not invented complete command.

families.source_residual: M chapter6 pp65–68 unavailable; exact post-detection sequence not independently complete
families.semantics: B default0 moves plunger to p2; B1 starts detection from current plunger position. p54 text includes visibly misplaced blowout instruction; do not infer complete B post-detection trajectory from this interleaved text. P p2 B1R after leading air and L p2 BR are distinct published sequences.

No default n1. p0 1–1000 ADC/default15; p1 1–100 ms/default5; p2 0–44000 absolute increments/default0; p3 100–1000 inc/s/default150; p4 500–44000 relative increments/default44000; p5 0 aspirate/default,1 dispense; p6 1–20 ms/default20; p7 1–3 CAN samples/default3, RS485 always1; p8 1–100 ms/default50 cLLD→pLLD interval. CAN packet interval=p6*p7. Parameters not robot-Z controls.

J0/default low0V,J1 high5V only GPO. U70/default pLLD,U71 mirror cLLD input,U72 hybrid,U73 GPO; U74/default GPI/cLLD,U75 emergency brake rising0→5V equivalent T; U76 LLD active-low,U77/default active-high. U70/72 success emits10ms pulse; U71 requires U74; GPO excludes LLD pulse/mirror. Existing controller mode, not permission to introduce host interlock.

n1 0 pressure,1 tip loss,2/3 digital rising/falling,4/5 cLLD rising/falling,6 pLLD/hLLD success. n2 0 disabled/default except cLLD,1 always,2 only during B/applicable cLLD/default cLLD. When digital-input and cLLD events both enabled only cLLD generated. Cannot save in NVRAM.

256 character assembled string; R execute/resume, X replay from beginning,C clear loaded buffer. Reports permitted while busy; p32 Q polling minimum100ms. Errors during execution terminate and erase loaded string. ACK not completion.
G0–50000/default0;0 endless until T. Up to20 g/G pairs nested or independent; not eight-dispense liquid-handling recommendation.

M0–30000 ms/default10;<10 becomes0; round to nearest10ms. During M:R terminates delay and continues;T ends delay/halts and R resumes;X error14 BUSY; new string executes. H halted status READY;n1=0/default R or digital transition,1 R only;n2=0/default falling,1 rising. Input stable20ms before/after edge and up to10ms additional execution delay. New string replaces halted sequence.

T gracefully terminates A/P/D/B/W/M; other individual commands complete first. Moving plunger ramps down to cutoff with high ramp-down rate. M remainder resumable; X after T replays beginning. ! reset highest priority even moving, cannot embed, immediately followed R. Reset is not synonymous with terminate/halt.
Write/read16 NVRAM byte locations0–15/default0; write data0–255/default0. Separate from program strings and command/error logs.

s location0–15/default0,string up to128 ASCII bytes/default Null; no inner R needed. e tail transfers control; following commands not executed; loops cannot span stored strings. Host e may appear within strings/loops. U30 run on startup indexed device address(0..15);U31/default disabled; reset required. DIP self-test overrides U30/31 and T ends self-test until power-cycle. Do not equate program location range with physical bus addressing capacity.
i explicitly saves v,V,c,L,h,K,p; r0/default reload NVRAM,r1 flash factory into working only. Subsequent power-cycle returns NVRAM unless explicit i; no automatic persistence inference.
Q0/default status error+READY;Q1 extended error data. &0/default part/revision,&1 downloaded ADP firmware string. Status meanings beyond table headings and detailed error codes not recovered.

?0/default commanded plunger increments;?1 true-home absolute incl calibration correction;?2 mm;?3 microliters;?4 backlash;?6/7/8 start/top/cutoff inc/s;?9/10 slope codes;?11/12 high/low drive current;?15 active current;?16 max increments incl overdrive;?17 total microliters;?18/19/20 speeds microliters/s. None measures delivered liquid.

?23 part/rev;26 enabled events ASCII;27 samples/CAN message;28 heartbeat seconds;29 ready0/busy1;30 digital0V/5V;31 tip0 absent1 present;32–39 p0,p1,p2,p3,p4,p5,p6,p8 respectively with original units.

40 operating min;41 power-ups;42/43 initialization total/since reset;44 calculated plunger meters;45/46 plunger moves total/since reset excluding init/eject;47/48 eject total/since reset;50/51/52 current/high/low supply volts;53/54/55 current/high/low Fahrenheit;56 ADC;57/58/59 current/high/low PSI;60 firmware download count.

61 compilation time;62 date;63 app version;64 boot part/rev;65 calculated32bit app checksum;67 buffer empty0/nonempty1;76 baud/protocol pipe-delimited fields;77 input/output/stream/pressure/tip module fields;80–95 stored strings;96 self-test;99 loaded string. Full ?76/?77 field labels retained in source pages.
: index1–100/default1 last error;100 errors NVRAM. = index1–1000/default1,length1–256/default1;1000 received chars NVRAM LIFO. = and Q/Q0 not logged; X logs X not expanded program.

ADC signed16bit two’s-complement hexadecimal ASCII; reduced response lacks status. OEM sequence optional and repeat flag must not be set if present; response also lacks ETX. DT/OEM/CAN formats differ. Not ordinary ? status-bearing parser.

U1/default Ch1 commands Ch2 pressure;U2 reverse;U3 Ch1 tip-loss Ch2 commands (RS485 line driver needed TTL conversion). U35/default autodetect first valid OEM/DT until power-cycle;U36 OEM;U37 DT. U41 9600,U47 38400,U48/default115200. These require reset. U80 stream enable,U81/default disable,U82 stream OEM,U83/default DT. Stream protocol distinct command protocol.

CAN100/125/250/500K/1M,default500K; baud reset required. U60 heartbeat enabled,U61/default disabled; only after boot sequence. b1–20/default2 in0.5s units auto-saved NVRAM (unlike o). Most setters/action frame1;report6;T also0;common commands2. Common-command identities, complete boot/addressing/frame layout unavailable.
U90/default pressure module on,U91 off;U92/default tip detect/eject on,U93 off;reset required. ER eject evidenced P p2, but full E parameter definition not recovered.

No default d selector. d0 minimum moving force in mA without step-loss;d1 step-loss detection pass/fail;d2 pressure sensor pass/fail. Busy while active; each diagnostic in string answers; error terminates string. Not passive sensor telemetry.
